bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qw_ovg u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qw_ovd.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qw_ovg_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qw_ovg_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qw_ovg_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qw_ovg  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: ovd split (Claude group-B r2/B3 10-14): qw_ovd_ref-w2 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT markers 16,481 -> 17,243): the 64x512 SRAM sat between the 4 x 1,024-b gather pins (W/S/N-west) and x (E) -> >= 1,600 b through two ~44-um channels (cut 0.75) and ~2,600 b of W-face fan-in in a 38.7-um W channel (2.6). The data head held two flows that share no signal (gather -> x; yc -> SRAM -> write beats), so it is split into ot_hgi_qw_ovg (gather, no macro) and ot_hgi_qw_ovs (SRAM + write side) with no seam and the same registers / reset relay depth: quant_wide_ov composition exact m0 PASS 3,328 words 184 cycles (= one-leaf 184/168), sk / w3 PASS, m1 / w1 / r2 mutants FAIL (EPYC4 gb3-ovsplit). This leaf: the gather (4 x 1,024 pin registers -> OR4 -> x 1,024), no macro.
